notes: Merged from two independent readings (apt4_fixtures_A.json, apt4_fixtures_B.json) of sheet fpC (קומה ג' +6.00). Items that agreed within ~5 cm are averaged; every disagreement was re-read on the sheet (renders and darkness profiles in work/apt4_merge). Central-wing items measured in M2R (-12,0,32.3), north-wing items (en-suite, master and bedroom-1 doors) in the global frame. All coordinates are global metres, the same frame as M3.json.

Checked against M3.json as of 2026-11-06 07:27:09 UTC (after the M3 checker's update). M3 wall indices changed in that update and may change again; door swings carry the M3 opening index ('m3_opening') AND their own x/z/w, so match by position if the indices move.

Counters: one entry per straight run; run B owns the corner square; the chamfered inner corner (drawn 45-degree front line) is an 'other' triangle with h 0..0.9. 'facing' on counters = unit vector from the wall into the room; a->b is ordered so that the room lies to the LEFT of a->b (facing = left normal (-dz, dx) of b-a). Upper cabinets are 'other' boxes with h_bottom/h_top (heights assumed).

Door swings: 'hinge' is a jamb end on the wall centreline, so the leaf exactly fills [x,z,w]. 'swing_dir' = unit vector from the wall line towards the side the leaf opens into, which is unambiguous where room names repeat (two 'ח. שינה'). 'room_index' = index in M3 rooms. 'hinge_drawn' = where the drawn leaf meets the wall (projected onto the wall centreline); drawn arcs are only 0.58-0.75 m in radius, smaller than the labels. 'geometry' says whether x/z/w are M3's opening or the drawn one. Sliders (270/230) and the hall-dining pass have no swing.

Not fixtures: thick dashed section-cut marks across bedroom 2 / hall; the framed box by the entry is the apartment area label (שטח עיקרי 104.38) with the circled '4' above it; the 60/80 internal window between bathroom and laundry.

Unlabelled symbols read by convention: washer (square + drum circle, could be a dryer), fridge (deep box at the end of run B), basins and kitchen sink (plain rectangles with a tap dot). Outline uncertainty +-3 cm where an edge lies on a dimension line (en-suite basin front, washer south edge).

FINAL CHECK (2026-11-06, work/apt4_final): every fixture and door swing drawn back on fpC both on the sheet itself (m2px) and in the M2R frame (-12,0,32.3) / global frame at res 150-300 and compared symbol by symbol: all outlines lie within ~3 cm of the drawn symbols (kitchen runs, chamfer, corner cooktop, sink, fridge box, dashed upper-cabinet line, both WCs, both basins, shower tray + drain, bathtub + drain, washer, AC box), every footprint lies inside its M3 room (apt 4) without entering a wall, counter a/b lie on the wall faces with depth into the room, every 'facing' points from its wall into the room, no floor fixture stands in a drawn door opening or in a door sweep (the bathtub does reach into M3's opening 10, see the M3 bathroom-door note), and the 8 swings match the drawn arcs (hinge side and direction). FIXED: (1) counter a/b order. The viewer (studio/src2/engine2.js fixtureRoom) tests the point 0.3 m to the LEFT of a->b first and takes the first room whose name equals 'room'; run B was ordered west->east, so that point fell in apt 5's kitchen (also named 'מטבח') and run B with the sink, cooktop and fridge would have been attached to apt 5. Both runs now have the room on the left of a->b (run A swapped too, for one consistent rule; the built geometry does not depend on the order). (2) fridge box re-measured by darkness scans: its back line is drawn at v_R 7.115, 5 cm in front of the party wall -> fridge_poly/size/centre updated (centre moved 1.7 cm).
